objective: Run the first host probe for the Ibex ROM/MMIO/LLM-proxy overlay and record whether the real CPU path reaches the LLM kick registers.
host_probe_command: artifacts/ibex_llm_soc_kick_obj_dir/tlul_slice_host_probe --reset-cycles 8 --post-reset-cycles 2000 --set cfg_valid_i=1 --set cfg_batch_length_i=4 --set cfg_req_valid_pct_i=100 --set cfg_rsp_valid_pct_i=100 --set cfg_host_d_ready_pct_i=100 --set cfg_device_a_ready_pct_i=100 --set cfg_put_full_pct_i=100 --set cfg_put_partial_pct_i=100 --set cfg_req_fill_target_i=4 --set cfg_rsp_fill_target_i=4 --set cfg_req_burst_len_max_i=1 --set cfg_seed_i=7 --set cfg_req_family_i=3 --set cfg_req_data_mode_i=5 --set cfg_rsp_data_mode_i=9 --set cfg_address_base_i=268435456 --set cfg_address_mask_i=255 --set cfg_reset_cycles_i=8

interpretation.measured_cpu_path: Ibex ibex_top executes the minimal RV32 ROM, performs 8 MMIO writes plus 1 status load through the data bus, restarts the quantized KV-cache proxy on command write, observes 5 proxy append requests, and reaches done.
interpretation.bus_model_note: The first passing host probe uses an overlay-local simple always-grant MMIO response shim with sticky data response valid for this first SoC boundary; this is not a production bus/interconnect claim.

non_claims: not coherent cache or interconnect integration
